title: Felix and the Choir
author: Ivo Fairweather
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
